_about: M3-CRE-659 post-import rules for Act I's crowd bodies (game/core/import/crowd_post_import.gd, AssetImportRules; ADR 0152): assets/crowd/<body>/<body>.glb, the LOD1 build of the characters' villager pipeline (assets_src/crowd/build_crowd.py). The same rules as the characters' villager folders (game/data/import/characters.json): each glTF material slot maps to <asset dir>/materials/<slot>.tres, Godot's auto LODs, no collision, and its group's shared clip library (M3-CRE-662: assets/crowd/clips/crowd_<library>_clips.tres: idle, talk, walk and the group's work clips) on an AnimationPlayer at the asset root. FieldNpc and VillagerLayer tint cloth and hair per person on top (NpcTints).

animations._about: M3-CRE-662: the crowd bodies share one clip library per group (assets_src/crowd/ranges.json clip_libraries; `libraries` is the same map, body -> library, which tools/validate_npc.py checks). CrowdClipLibrary (game/world/npc/crowd_clip_library.gd, run by crowd_post_import.gd) fills {library} in `library`, names the body's armature node `armature` (the library's tracks are rooted there) and sets its Skeleton3D's motion_scale to the body's `hips_bone` rest height over the library's `hips_meta` metadata (the reference body's), so the hips track fits each body's height. AssetImportRules then puts the library on an AnimationPlayer at the asset root, 0.3 s default blend.
